73019: A girl with the power to read minds. Her power has caused her harsh experiences since she was a child, so she's closed off her heart to others. But the truth is that she's still just a normal, weak girl who longs to be with someone.
73021: A healthy young, high school boy who always has sex on the brain. Despite his loose appearance, he's a handsome man who hates twisted things. He's also generous, and doesn't mind Haruka's power at all.
73023: The president of the ESP Research Club. Her mother was a clairvoyant similar to Haruka, who would often assist in police investigations. However, she was accused of being a fake and hung herself, bringing shame to her family and horrifying Yuriko who believed in her.
73025: Daichi is the childhood friend of Yuriko. When around the club members of ESP Research Club, he has a laid-back appearance and is usually seen reading a book. When he is alone with Yuriko, he tends to be more serious, and his eyes are visible.
73027: One of Haruka and Manabe's classmates. Unlike Haruka, Hiyori is a social girl. She's set to inherit her family's dojo, but she's not very enthusiastic about the idea. She has a crush on Manabe, so she tends to lash out at Haruka for getting his attention.
77057: Haruka's apparently wealthy grandfather. One of the few people to stick by her after Kumiko disowned her. He is slightly perverted, having dirty thoughts about his kinship with Haruka.
77061: Haruka's father who divorces her mother because he was unable to bear Haruka's ability, especially when he needs to keep his secret affair from Haruka's mother.
77063: A monk who is a family friend at a shrine temple in Haruka's hometown. His encounter with Haruka has led to him taken an interest in esper abilities.
77099: She was a kindergarten playmate of Kotoura Haruka.
80633: A police detective. He appears to be familiar with the events that occurred surrounding Yuriko's mother, although he himself is skeptic of supernatural abilities.
80635: Ishiyama's detective partner who is a bit clumsy and usually hungry.
